description: Whitelist of licenses compatible with proprietary/commercial use

allowed_licenses.name: MIT
allowed_licenses.notes: Permissive, allows commercial use and modification

allowed_licenses.name: Boost Software License 1.0
allowed_licenses.notes: Permissive for both source and binary

allowed_licenses.name: MPL 2.0
allowed_licenses.notes: Weak copyleft, files can be used in proprietary software

additional_notes: Licenses NOT in this whitelist (especially GPL/AGPL) are prohibited
Dual-licensed code must use a whitelisted license option
Always verify dependency licenses during dependency updates
Maintain an audit log of all license compliance checks
